gives: Reaper Coin shed from its coin-scale ridge (1 in 6 days, a dice roll)
livestock.breeds: 2 fed goats + full pen, 1 kid per 3 days; coat inherits from parents

gives: eggs: d6 roll per dawn; 6 = golden egg (sells or hatches)
livestock.breeds: golden egg hatches into a hen

survival_loop: Water: storm cistern fills from Sky Director rain (wetness up to x2), dice spring always flows; channels feed the garden, a pipe feeds the pen troughs (water.json).
Ledger trees grow coinfruit at dawn (Sky Director OnDawn); rain doubles yield (GetWetness > 0.5).
Wager herbs grow 4 stages, one stage per in-game day; storms skip a stage for Stormbloom only.
Player eats coinfruit, eggs, milk, cheese, bread (coinfruit + hen egg at the felt-table oven).
Goats eat Hedgeleaf + windfall; hens eat Vigweed seed + pulp. Unfed animals stop producing after 1 day, leave after 3.
Coins from goats/golden eggs are staked at the odds boards to buy seed packs: the island is self-sufficient but rewards smart bets.
Thirst: player drinks 3 L/day (waterskin or any source); unwatered animals stop producing after 1 day and leave after 3.
